backtest.design: monthly pseudo-real-time origins 2024-10-01 to 2026-09-01; model and data as known at each origin; mature windows only (o + h + 75 days <= 2026-10-01); company and organizations with n >= 50; voluntary_departures@2

calibration.design: individual predicted 3-month voluntary cumulative incidence at mature monthly origins against observed departures; deciles; team-cluster bootstrap 80% intervals; bins with n >= 10 only

commands: uv run --project engine staysignal eval backtest
uv run --project engine staysignal eval backtest --futures 2000
uv run --project engine staysignal eval effects

comparison.design: the six quarterly origins whose 6-month window is mature; company and organizations; voluntary_departures@2; every model sees data as known at the origin except the oracle, which knows the true state

effects.design: partial dependence of the mean 3-month voluntary cumulative incidence over the population at 2026-10-01 (model m2026.09, voluntary_departures@2), one feature set to each grid value at a time; 80% bands from 20 parameter draws; associational, not causal

label: synthetic world: these numbers test the pipeline and the uncertainty method, not real-world accuracy
